newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish city of Lodz mulls PLN 70 mln eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Polish city of Lodz mulls PLN 70 mln eurobond.

text.p: The Polish city of Lodz is considering a eurobond issue to raise some 70 million zlotys at turn of 1997, but has not yet decided in which currency, the city's spokesman said on Monday.
"The eurobond issue project is in its initial stage. We are now organising a tender for the leader of the issue which should be concluded in the second half of March," Witold Rosset told Reuters.
"We do not yet know in which currency the bonds would be denominated. It will depend on analysis and recommendations made by the leader," he said.
Rosset added the success of the issue would depend on the credit rating Lodz expected to receive within two months but declined to say which rating agency was reviewing Lodz. @
If the Lodz issue materialises, it will be the first eurobond issued by a Polish city. Warsaw was also considering a eurobond of up to $100 million, but made no decision so far.
Poland has a credit rating of Baa3 from Moody's, BBB- from Standard and Poor's and BBB from IBCA.
